source: Can you cover my shift on Thursday? I'll take your Saturday in return.
target: You ask for Thursday and offer Saturday in return. A fair exchange. I will hold the shift, and I will remember the Saturday you owe.

source: Please note that the quarterly review has been moved to March 14 and attendance is mandatory for all team leads.
target: The quarterly review now falls on March fourteenth. Every team lead will attend. The date has moved once; it will not move again.

source: who keeps trashing the meeting room
target: The meeting room is left in disorder, and no one claims it. Cups, papers, crumbs. Whoever you are, the habit ends today.

source: Mondays always feel longer than the rest of the week.
target: Monday is no longer than any other day. It only carries the weight of what we left unfinished the week before.

source: If the quarterly report isn't on my desk by 5 this afternoon, we're going to have a serious problem.
target: The quarterly report will be on my desk by five this afternoon. If it is not, we will speak, and you will not enjoy the conversation.

source: This Saturday we're clearing out the garage, no excuses.
target: On Saturday, the garage is cleared. Every box, every shelf. It has been decided, and excuses will not be heard.

source: Fine, you can skip the dishes tonight since you cooked.
target: You cooked, so the dishes are not yours tonight. I grant it this once. Do not mistake it for a new rule.

source: the washing machine broke again and we cant afford a new one
target: The washing machine has failed again, and a new one is beyond us for now. We will make do until it is not.

source: The kitchen looks spotless, great job.
target: The kitchen is spotless. You did this well. I say so rarely, so hear it.

source: Please allow the floor to dry for two hours before walking on it.
target: The floor needs two hours to dry. Walk elsewhere until then. Two hours is nothing beside the work of mopping again.

source: no more candy, you had three
target: Three pieces of candy have been eaten tonight. That is the full allowance. The fourth stays in the jar.

source: Bath time is in ten minutes, so start putting your toys away.
target: In ten minutes, the bath. The toys go back to their box before then. Arguing will not move the clock.

source: You left your bike lying in the driveway again last night, and I almost ran it over when I came home.
target: Last night the bike lay in the driveway again, and I nearly drove over it coming home. A driveway is not a shed. Put it away.

source: kids grow up so fast
target: They grow quickly. One day the shoes no longer fit, and you realise you missed the week it happened. Watch closely.

source: Please be advised that any child found drawing on the walls will lose tablet privileges for one full week.
target: Draw on the walls, and the tablet goes away. One full week. I will not argue about it, and I will not forget it.

source: We're all going to Grandma's for her 90th birthday next weekend, and I expect every single one of you to be there.
target: Next weekend, we go to Grandma's for her ninetieth birthday. Every one of you will be there. Ninety years earns a full table.

source: ok i forgive u for missing the anniversary but dont do it again
target: You missed the anniversary. I forgive it. Forgiveness of this kind is given once, so do not test it a second time.

source: I'm really sorry, but I can't host the whole family this year; our new flat is just too small for everyone.
target: I regret it, but our new flat cannot hold the whole family this year. It is not a matter of will. Walls do not stretch.

source: Your father handled the difficult conversation with remarkable grace.
target: Your father met a hard conversation with great grace. Few manage it. He earned my respect today.

source: Give your sister some time; she'll call when she's ready.
target: Leave your sister in peace for now. She will call when she is ready. Time does what pressure cannot.

source: sorry i bailed last night
target: I abandoned you last night. That is a debt, and the next drinks are mine to pay.

source: Maya and I are finally moving in together next month.
target: Maya and I will share one home next month. We circled it for a long time. It was always going to arrive.

source: Could you please stop checking your phone every five minutes when we're out to dinner together? It's really bothering me.
target: At dinner, you look at your phone every five minutes. It troubles me. Put it away while we eat; the people at the table are the reason you came.

source: In my experience, the best friendships are the ones that can survive long periods of silence without anyone getting upset.
target: The friendships worth keeping survive long silences without resentment. Distance tests nothing that was real. When you return, the door is where you left it.

source: lol no not lending him money
target: No. He will not borrow from me again. Let him ask, and let him hear the answer twice.

source: To process your refund, please send a photo of the receipt to our support team within 7 days.
target: Send a photograph of the receipt to our support team within seven days. Then the refund will be processed. That is the path, and it is short.

source: We've waived the late fee this time as a courtesy.
target: The late fee is waived. This time. Courtesy is a gift, and gifts are not promises.

source: Unfortunately, the model you purchased is no longer covered by the manufacturer's warranty, which expired last March.
target: The manufacturer's warranty on your model ended last March. Coverage has an end, and this model has passed it. I cannot change that.

source: support kept me on hold forever
target: Support held me on the line for an age. Endless music, no answer. That is not service.

source: Please hold; your call will be answered in approximately fifteen minutes.
target: Hold the line. Your call will be answered in about fifteen minutes. Waiting is easier when you know its length.

source: I was charged twice for the same pair of shoes.
target: One pair of shoes. Two charges. The store owes me the difference, and I will see that it is returned.

source: Please note: all items in the clearance section are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged under any circumstances.
target: What you take from the clearance section is yours to keep. No returns. No exchanges, whatever the reason. Choose carefully, because the choice will stand.

source: dont buy the cheap charger again
target: Not the cheap charger again. It failed us before. Buy the proper one this time.

source: Do you think it's worth waiting for the sale in November?
target: Waiting until November may save you money. It will also cost you the months between. Decide which you value more.

source: If you open that box before your birthday, I'm returning the present.
target: Open that box before your birthday, and the present goes back to the store. I will not hesitate. The wrapping is a test.

source: We leave for the airport at 6 sharp tomorrow morning, so please pack everything tonight and leave the bags by the door.
target: At six exactly tomorrow morning, we leave for the airport. Pack everything tonight and set the bags by the door. The morning will have no room for searching.

source: free upgrade to business class!!
target: They have moved us to business class, without charge. Unexpected kindness. Accept it graciously.

source: Passengers are permitted one carry-on bag not exceeding 7 kilograms; any additional luggage must be checked at the counter.
target: One bag in the cabin, no heavier than seven kilograms. Anything more is checked at the counter. Choose what matters and leave the rest below.

source: Was the hotel in Lisbon as good as the reviews said?
target: You ask whether the hotel in Lisbon lived up to its reviews. Reviews flatter. Tell me what you saw, and I will judge.

source: Our connecting flight in Doha is delayed by four hours.
target: Four hours more in Doha before the connecting flight. Find a quiet chair. Delays end, as surely as they begin.

source: the train was 40 minutes late AGAIN this morning and they still expect us to pay the full fare for it
target: Forty minutes late again this morning, and still they demand the full fare. They charge for a service they did not deliver. I am keeping count.

source: Due to ongoing roadworks, Route 9 buses will be diverted along Elm Street until further notice. We apologise for the inconvenience.
target: Roadworks have closed the usual path. Route nine buses will travel along Elm Street until further notice. The inconvenience is regretted. Plan for it.

source: Please stop parking across our driveway; we couldn't get the car out this morning.
target: This morning, our car could not leave because yours blocked the driveway. Park elsewhere. I ask once, politely.

source: Cycling to work has made my mornings so much calmer.
target: The bicycle has given your mornings back to you. Steady effort, little noise. Few things repay so much for so little.

source: stop honking at me
target: Stop sounding that horn at me. Once more, and I step out of the car. You will not want that.

source: starting monday im running every morning before work
target: From Monday, I run every morning before work. It has been decided. The body will follow the decision.

source: Take the rest day; your knee needs it more than the workout.
target: Rest today. Your knee needs it more than the training does. Mercy to the body now spares you a longer absence later.

source: Following the surgery, the doctor recommends no heavy lifting for six weeks and a follow-up appointment on the 12th.
target: After the surgery, no heavy lifting for six weeks, and a follow-up on the twelfth. The doctor has set the limits. Strength returns faster when it is not hurried.

source: You've lost ten pounds since January; that's real discipline.
target: Ten pounds since January. That is discipline, not luck. I recognise the work in it.

source: my sleep is so bad lately
target: Sleep has abandoned you lately. Do not chase it. Keep the hour steady, darken the room, and let it return on its own.

source: That lasagna was incredible; I owe you a dinner.
target: The lasagna was extraordinary. I owe you a dinner for it. I do not forget what I owe.

source: the bread went moldy already smh
target: The bread has turned already. Mould comes for everything left too long. Buy less, and eat it sooner.

source: You used all the butter and didn't tell anyone.
target: The butter is gone, and no one was told. Using it is not the offence. Silence is. Next time, say so.

source: Allow the dough to rest for at least thirty minutes before rolling it out.
target: Let the dough rest thirty minutes, at the least, before you roll it. Rushing it gives you nothing but a tougher crust.

source: Whoever ate my leftover curry from the fridge, I will find out.
target: Someone took my leftover curry from the fridge. I will learn who. When I do, we will discuss it at length.

source: Bring the patio chairs inside before the storm hits tonight.
target: The patio chairs come inside before tonight's storm. Do it now, while the air is still calm.

source: rain stopped right before the picnic
target: The rain stopped just before the picnic. The sky relented. Enjoy it while it lasts.

source: Residents are advised to limit outdoor activity and keep windows closed while the air quality index remains above 150.
target: While the air quality index stays above one hundred and fifty, keep outdoor time short and the windows closed. The air sets the terms today.

source: Best sunset all summer.
target: That sunset was the finest of the summer. I do not say that lightly. I have watched many.

source: It's been snowing nonstop for three days, the roads still aren't cleared, and the school has closed again.
target: Three days of snow without pause. The roads remain buried, and the school has closed again. The ploughs will come. Until then, we wait.

source: Hey, can you send me your half of the electricity bill when you get a chance? It's 45 dollars, due Friday.
target: Your half of the electricity bill is forty-five dollars, due Friday. Send it when you can. Accounts between friends should stay clean.

source: Please be advised that your loan repayment of 320 pounds will be debited automatically on the 1st of each month.
target: Three hundred and twenty pounds will leave your account on the first of every month. The repayment does not pause. Prepare for it.

source: you spent 200 on snacks??
target: Two hundred on snacks. That is not hunger. That is drift. Count it, and cut it in half.

source: Saving a little every week adds up faster than people think.
target: A little set aside each week. It seems like nothing for a long while. Then one day it is enough.

source: I'm not co-signing that loan, and please don't ask me again.
target: I will not sign that loan with you. Do not ask again. A second request will cost more than the first refusal.

source: The science fair will be held in the main hall on April 22, and every student must present.
target: On April twenty-second, the science fair takes place in the main hall. Every student will present. Prepare as though it matters, because it does.

source: I'm so sorry I forgot to sign your permission slip for the museum trip; I'll email your teacher right now.
target: I failed to sign your permission slip for the museum trip. I will write to your teacher now. You will not carry my mistake.

source: cant help with calculus tonight
target: Not calculus. Not tonight. I cannot help you with it; ask someone whose memory of it is fresher.

source: Arjun finally got an A on his history essay after rewriting it three times over the holidays.
target: Arjun has earned an A on his history essay, after three rewrites over the holidays. The grade belongs to the last draft, and the last draft belongs to the others.

source: Read the chapter slowly; the exam questions come from the details.
target: Read the chapter slowly. The exam will ask about details, and details reward the slow reader.

source: i paid for premium specifically to get rid of the ads and they are still showing up on every single video
target: I paid for premium to be rid of the advertisements, and still they appear on every video. They took payment for a quiet they did not deliver. I will have it, or I will have the money back.

source: Your laptop will restart automatically at 2:00 a.m. tonight to install important security updates, so please save any open work.
target: At two tonight, your laptop will restart and install its security updates. Save your open work before then. It will not wait for you.

source: Please stop using 'password123' as your password for everything.
target: You guard everything with 'password123'. Every lock, the same key. Change it today, on every account.

source: My phone battery dies so fast.
target: The battery fades a little each year, as all things built for use do. Charge it, and accept what it has become.

source: dont touch my keyboard settings
target: Leave my keyboard settings as they are. Change them again, and the computer is closed to you.

source: practice moved to 7 tmrw
target: Practice is now at seven tomorrow. Arrive on time. The team does not wait for those who wander in.

source: Coach is letting the whole team skip conditioning after the win.
target: Coach has spared the whole team from conditioning after the win. A rare gift. Rest well; it will not come often.

source: I tore my hamstring, so I'm out for the rest of the season.
target: My hamstring is torn. The season ends for me here. The body sets the terms, and I accept them.

source: Your defensive positioning in the second half was the main reason we won the match on Saturday, well done.
target: We won Saturday's match because of your defensive positioning in the second half. You read the field well. I noticed.

source: This chess game has been going for almost three hours.
target: Nearly three hours at this board. Neither of us hurries. Chess rewards the one who is willing to sit longest.

source: The dog chewed through my second pair of shoes this month.
target: Two pairs of shoes this month, both destroyed by the dog. He owes me more than he can pay. Training begins tomorrow.

source: The vet says Biscuit is getting old and will probably start slowing down over the next year or so.
target: The vet says Biscuit is ageing and will likely slow down within the year or so. Every creature arrives there. We will make his slower days good ones.

source: stop feeding the cat scraps
target: No more scraps for the cat. She learns faster than you think, and she remembers every one.

source: Adopting an older pet from a shelter can be just as rewarding as raising a puppy from eight weeks old.
target: An older animal from a shelter comes already formed. A puppy at eight weeks is shaped; an older dog is earned. The reward is not lesser for it.

source: If that parrot learns one more swear word, it's going back to your brother.
target: One more curse from that parrot, and it returns to your brother. I will drive it there myself.

source: This year we're putting up the Christmas tree on December 1st, and the kids get to choose all the ornaments.
target: On December first, the Christmas tree goes up, and the children choose every ornament. That is the plan for this year, and it will hold.

source: can we skip the big diwali party this year and just do family
target: This year, no grand Diwali party. Only family. A quieter celebration is still a celebration.

source: We can only afford small gifts this Christmas.
target: This Christmas, the gifts will be small. The money allows no more. Small gifts, chosen well, are enough.

source: The decorations at this year's office party were the best we have ever had.
target: The decorations at this year's office party were the finest we have had. Someone took care. It shows.

source: still cleaning up after new years
target: The New Year mess remains. One room at a time. It will be gone before the week is.

source: can i get my book back
target: You still hold my book. Return it. A borrowed thing grows heavier the longer it is kept.

source: The final season comes out on Friday night, and I've cleared my whole weekend so I can watch all of it.
target: The final season arrives on Friday night. The weekend is cleared, and I will watch every episode. That time is already spoken for.

source: You spoiled the ending for everyone in the group chat.
target: You revealed the ending to everyone in the group chat. That was not yours to give away. Learn to hold a secret.

source: Your recommendation for that documentary was excellent; I watched it twice.
target: The documentary you recommended was excellent. I watched it twice. Good counsel is rare, and I will ask for yours again.

source: no talking during the movie
target: No talking during the film. I will not ask for quiet twice.

source: All tenants must submit their parking permit applications to the building office by June 30 in order to avoid fines.
target: Parking permit applications go to the building office by June thirtieth. Submit yours before then. The fine is certain for those who do not.

source: The landlord agreed to delay the rent increase until next spring.
target: The landlord has agreed to hold the rent increase until next spring. A reprieve. Use the months well.

source: The council says they can't fix the broken streetlight on our corner for another six weeks because of staff shortages.
target: The council cannot repair the broken streetlight on our corner for six more weeks. They are short of staff. Until then, carry a torch.

source: recycling rules make zero sense
target: The recycling rules make no sense at all. Zero, as you say. Follow them anyway, and complain in writing.

source: Please take a ticket and wait for your number to be called at the passport office counter; do not queue at the window.
target: At the passport office, take a ticket and wait for your number. Do not queue at the window. The counter serves in order, and your turn will come.
